summary: Samples the first input according to trigger behavior from the second input and holds the captured values until the next sample event.
key_concepts: Samples channels from the first input and uses the second input as the trigger source.
Sample modes choose rising edge, high level, falling edge, low level, or trigger value change behavior.
Hold Last continues sampling while on and holds values while off, which is easy to misread in generated plans.
Hold Last Pulse immediately samples the input and holds that captured value.
Hold per Sample applies the hold to each sample for multi-sample channels instead of only the last sample.

key_params.name: sample
key_params.note: When to sample: off-to-on, while on, on-to-off, while off, or value change

key_params.name: whileon
key_params.note: Sample while trigger is above zero

key_params.name: hold
key_params.note: Continue sampling while on, or hold values while off

key_params.name: holdsamples
key_params.note: Hold each sample rather than only the last sample

common_gotchas: The default behavior samples on a 0-to-1 style event from input 2.
In off-to-on mode, Hold does not resample while the second input stays high and does not sample on the falling edge.
Input 1 supplies values; input 2 controls sampling.
Hold per Sample matters for multi-sample channels because normal hold behavior works on the current channel value.
For continuous latch behavior, choose While On or Value Change rather than Off to On.
